item.title: Integration Guide
item.description:
Overview

The Humly integration forwards sensor measurements from Haltian IoT to the Humly Control Panel API so that Humly can display sensor data - temperature, humidity, CO2, occupancy/motion, and presence - against its rooms and desks. Haltian’s connector service pushes data one way, from Haltian IoT to Humly; Humly does not call back into Haltian IoT. The integration is multi-tenant: each Haltian organization has its own connection to a Humly Control Panel instance.

item.title: Supported Sensors
item.description:
Overview

The Humly connector consumes Haltian IoT sensor measurements and converts them into Humly sensor readings. It maps a small, fixed list of measurement types to Humly sensor types - it does not have a concept of per-device or per-sensor configuration presets.

This page lists the Haltian sensors that emit supported measurement types today, what each sensor reports, and how that data appears in Humly.

item.title: Frequently Asked Questions
item.description:
General

What is the Humly integration?

The Humly Connector is a service, owned by Haltian, that forwards Haltian IoT sensor measurements to the Humly Control Panel API. This lets Humly display sensor-derived data - such as temperature, humidity, CO₂, and presence/motion - against the rooms and desks managed in Humly’s own platform. The connector is multi-tenant: each Haltian organization that enables the integration gets its own configuration and its own connection to Humly.
